caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure positioned on a rectangular pedestal. The figure has medium brown skin and long, dark brown hair, and wears a yellow tunic-like garment with teal, red, and yellow trim, along with a large necklace. Draped on the figure's left shoulder and around the waist is a fabric featuring red and teal feathers. On the head is a gold headband or helmet decorated with three large, upright feathers—two red and one yellow, with green/blue bases. The figure's left arm holds a bundle of cigars, while the right hand also grasps a single cigar. On the left bicep is a gold armband with “J.M.” inscribed in brown letters. The crossing legs are partially covered with yellow and red leggings, and brown shoes or moccasins are worn on the feet. The blue-green pedestal base is inscribed on the front and right sides in yellow uppercase letters with the words “J. M. ANTHONY CIGARS.” The background of the drawing is an off-white, blank surface.
title: Cigar Store Indian
